meta.name: game-bootstrap
meta.description: Godot 4 project scaffolding — project.godot, architecture notes, script stubs, scene builders, build order. Load after game decomposition.

copy.tagline: 快速搭建 Godot 4 项目骨架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Godot 4 开始一个新游戏项目
copy.fit_line_en: For you if starting a new game project with Godot 4

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为 Godot 4 游戏项目生成完整的工程骨架，包括 project.godot 配置文件、架构说明文档、脚本存根和场景构建器。它不编写游戏逻辑，只定义结构和连接关系。
howto.when: 当你描述一个新游戏项目或提出增量修改请求时触发。通常在你提供游戏描述或变更需求后自动开始工作。

say.text: 帮我为一个2D平台游戏搭建Godot项目骨架。
给现有项目添加一个敌人角色，更新架构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a complete Godot 4 project skeleton: project.godot config, architecture notes, script stubs, and scene builders. It defines structure and connections, not behavior.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a new game project or request incremental changes. Typically starts automatically after you provide a game description or change request.

say_en.text: Scaffold a Godot project for a 2D platformer.
say_en.note: Claude generates project.godot, architecture notes, scripts, and scene builders.

say_en.text: Add an enemy character to the existing project and update the architecture.
